::: {.key-question}
What external factors influence health and wellbeing for Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people and families in the NEPHU catchment, including in supporting children and strong families?
:::

## Usual Health Care Provider

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Usual health service
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
hsu_usual <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_HSU_Usual.csv")

# Data wrangling
hsu_usual <- hsu_usual %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(other_n    = hospital_n + traditional_healer_n + other_n,
                answered_n = sum(across(aboriginal_medical_service_community_clinic_n:no_usual_place_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(ams_n     = aboriginal_medical_service_community_clinic_n,
                gp_n      = doctor_gp_other_than_from_aboriginal_medical_service_n,
                nousual_n = no_usual_place_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(ams_n:nousual_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("gp"),
                starts_with("ams"),
                starts_with("other"),
                starts_with("nousual"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "gp"       = "General practitioner",
                                              "ams"      = "AMS or Community Clinic",
                                              "other"    = "Other",
                                              "nousual"  = "No usual place",
                                              "answered" = "Total"),
                                levels = c("General practitioner",
                                           "AMS or Community Clinic",
                                           "Other",
                                           "No usual place",
                                           "Total")))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Actions taken for health in previous two weeks
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
hsu_actions <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_HSU_Actions.csv")

# Data wrangling
hsu_actions <- hsu_actions %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(hospital_n = discharged_from_hospital_inpatient_episode_n + visited_casualty_emergency_outpatients_day_clinic_n,
                other_n    = consulted_an_alcohol_and_drug_worker_n + consulted_a_nurse_n + consulted_a_social_worker_welfare_officer_n + consulted_a_traditional_healer_n + consulted_an_other_health_professional_n,
                answered_n = total_n) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(gp_n      = consulted_a_gp_n,
                dentist_n = consulted_a_dentist_2_years_n,
                ahw_n     = consulted_an_aboriginal_health_worker_n,
                none_n    = no_actions_taken_in_last_2_weeks_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(gp_n:other_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("gp"),
                starts_with("dentist"),
                starts_with("ahw"),
                starts_with("hospital"),
                starts_with("other"),
                starts_with("none"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "gp"       = "General practitioner",
                                              "dentist"  = "Dentist",
                                              "ahw"      = "Aboriginal Health Worker",
                                              "hospital" = "Hospital",
                                              "other"    = "Other",
                                              "none"     = "None",
                                              "answered" = "Total"),
                                levels = c("General practitioner",
                                           "Dentist",
                                           "Aboriginal Health Worker",
                                           "Hospital",
                                           "Other",
                                           "None",
                                           "Total")))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Private health insurance
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
hsu_insurance <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_HSU_Insurance.csv")

# Data wrangling
hsu_insurance <- hsu_insurance %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(answered_n = sum(across(with_private_health_insurance_n:without_private_health_insurance_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(insurance_n   = with_private_health_insurance_n,
                noinsurance_n = without_private_health_insurance_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(insurance_n:noinsurance_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("insurance"),
                starts_with("noinsurance"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "insurance"   = "Yes",
                                              "noinsurance" = "No",
                                              "answered"    = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Yes",
                                           "No",
                                           "Total")))
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-peoples/national-aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-health-survey/latest-release).

- 83% (approximately 31,900 people) of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents living in Greater Melbourne reported that they usually visited a general practitioner when they had a problem with their health, and a further 9.3% (approximately 3,600 people) visited an Aboriginal Medical Service or Community Clinic.

- 5.7% (approximately 2,200 people) did not have a usual healthcare provider that they went to when they had a problem with their health, and males were more likely to not have a usual health care provider than females (7.1% vs. 4.0%).

- During the two weeks prior to the survey 24% (approximately 9,200 people) of survey respondents living in Greater Melbourne consulted a general practitioner for health-related reasons.

- Overall, 29% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents aged 15 years and over living in Greater Melbourne were covered by private health insurance. This equates to approximately 8,000 Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people.

- Females were more likely to be covered by private health insurance than males (46% vs. 12%).

::: {.callout-tip title="Definitions and notes about this topic" icon=false collapse=false}
- Data for this topic were collected from all people completing the 2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey.

```{r}

factor_levels <- stringr::str_wrap(levels(hsu_usual$answer), width = 10)

  dplyr::filter(sex != "Total" & answer != "Total") %>%
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(stringr::str_wrap(answer, width = 10), levels = factor_levels)) %>% 
  #
  f_bar_grouped_sex(x_variable = answer,
                    y_variable = n,
                    x_angle    = 90)

  dplyr::filter(sex != "Total" & answer != "Total") %>%
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(stringr::str_wrap(answer, width = 10), levels = factor_levels)) %>% 
  #

f_bar_grouped_combine(figure_number, figure_percent)
```

## General Practitioners and Health Professionals

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GP visits - time since last consultation
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
gp_status <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_GP_Status.csv")

# Data wrangling
gp_status <- gp_status %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(week2_n    = saw_gp_in_last_2_weeks_n + saw_specialist_in_last_2_weeks_but_not_a_gp_n,
                answered_n = sum(across(saw_gp_in_last_2_weeks_n:saw_gp_more_than_12_months_ago_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(month3_n     = saw_gp_more_than_2_weeks_to_less_than_3_months_ago_n,
                month6_n     = saw_gp_3_months_to_less_than_6_months_ago_n,
                month12_n    = saw_gp_6_months_to_less_than_12_months_ago_n,
                yearormore_n = saw_gp_more_than_12_months_ago_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(month3_n:week2_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("week2"),
                starts_with("month3"),
                starts_with("month6"),
                starts_with("month12"),
                starts_with("yearormore"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "week2"      = "Less than 2 weeks",
                                              "month3"     = "2 weeks to 3 months",
                                              "month6"     = "3 to 6 months",
                                              "month12"    = "6 to 12 months",
                                              "yearormore" = "More than 12 months",
                                              "answered"   = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Less than 2 weeks",
                                           "2 weeks to 3 months",
                                           "3 to 6 months",
                                           "6 to 12 months",
                                           "More than 12 months",
                                           "Total")))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GP visits - lifestyle topics
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
gp_topics <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_GP_Topics.csv")

# Data wrangling
gp_topics <- gp_topics %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(sexual_n   = family_planning_n + safe_sexual_practices_n,
                answered_n = total_n - not_applicable_n - did_not_discuss_not_known_if_discussed_health_lifestyle_issues_in_last_12_months_n) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(smoking_n  = reducing_or_quitting_smoking_n,
                alcohol_n  = drinking_alcohol_in_moderation_n,
                drug_n     = drug_use_n,
                weight_n   = reaching_a_healthy_weight_n,
                activity_n = increasing_physical_activity_n,
                diet_n     = eating_healthy_food_or_improving_diet_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(smoking_n:sexual_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("smoking"),
                starts_with("alcohol"),
                starts_with("drug"),
                starts_with("weight"),
                starts_with("activity"),
                starts_with("diet"),
                starts_with("sexual"),
                starts_with("other"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "smoking"  = "Smoking",
                                              "alcohol"  = "Alcohol use",
                                              "drug"     = "Substance use",
                                              "weight"   = "Healthy weight",
                                              "activity" = "Physical activity",
                                              "diet"     = "Healthy eating",
                                              "sexual"   = "Sexual health",
                                              "other"    = "Other",
                                              "answered" = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Smoking",
                                           "Alcohol use",
                                           "Substance use",
                                           "Healthy weight",
                                           "Physical activity",
                                           "Healthy eating",
                                           "Sexual health",
                                           "Other",
                                           "Total")))
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-peoples/national-aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-health-survey/latest-release).

- Overall, 51% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents living in Greater Melbourne reported that they had visited a general practitioner or specialist during the three months prior to the survey. This equates to approximately 20,200 Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people.

- Females were more likely than males to have last visited a general practitioner or specialist more than 12 months prior to the survey (17% vs. 11%).

- For people who had visited a general practitioner or health professional during the 12 months prior to the survey and who had discussed a lifestyle issue, the most common lifestyle issues discussed were increasing physical activity (56%, approximately 5,700 people), reaching a healthy weight (50%, approximately 5,000 people), and healthy eating (35%, approximately 3,500 people).

- For people who had discussed lifestyle issues with a general practitioner or health professional, males were more likely than females to have discussed reducing or quitting smoking (38% vs. 21%), drinking alcohol in moderation (40% vs. 13%), or substance use (37% vs. 21%), while females were more likely to have discussed reaching a healthy weight (55% vs.46%), healthy eating (53% vs. 24%), or sexual health (including family planning) (45% vs. 9.5%).

::: {.callout-tip title="Definitions and notes about this topic" icon=false collapse=false}
- Data for this topic were collected from all people completing the 2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey.

## Dentists and Dental Professionals

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dentist visits - time since last consultation
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
dentist_status <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_Dentist_Status.csv")

# Data wrangling
dentist_status <- dentist_status %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(answered_n = sum(across(last_2_weeks_n:never_seen_health_professional_about_teeth_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(week2_n     = last_2_weeks_n,
                month3_n    = more_than_2_weeks_to_less_than_3_months_ago_n,
                month6_n    = x3_months_to_less_than_6_months_ago_n,
                month12_n   = x6_months_to_less_than_12_months_ago_n,
                year2_n     = x12_months_to_less_than_2_years_ago_n,
                moreyear2_n = x2_years_ago_or_more_n,
                never_n     = never_seen_health_professional_about_teeth_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(week2_n:never_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("week2"),
                starts_with("month3"),
                starts_with("month6"),
                starts_with("month12"),
                starts_with("year2"),
                starts_with("moreyear2"),
                starts_with("never"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "week2"      = "Less than 2 weeks",
                                              "month3"     = "2 weeks to 3 months",
                                              "month6"     = "3 to 6 months",
                                              "month12"    = "6 to 12 months",
                                              "year2"      = "12 months to 2 years",
                                              "moreyear2"  = "More than 2 years",
                                              "never"      = "Never",
                                              "answered"   = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Less than 2 weeks",
                                           "2 weeks to 3 months",
                                           "3 to 6 months",
                                           "6 to 12 months",
                                           "12 months to 2 years",
                                           "More than 2 years",
                                           "Never",
                                           "Total")))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dentist visits - location of last consultation
# Data from ABS Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in NATSIHS data
dentist_type <- f_read_natsihs_sex("Indicator_Vic_Sex_Dentist_Type.csv")

# Data wrangling
dentist_type <- dentist_type %>% 
  dplyr::rowwise() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(answered_n = sum(across(private_dental_clinic_including_specialist_n:other_n))) %>% 
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
  #
  janitor::adorn_totals(fill = "Total") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename(private_n    = private_dental_clinic_including_specialist_n,
                government_n = government_dental_clinic_including_dental_hospital_n,
                school_n     = school_dental_clinic_n,
                ams_n        = dentist_at_aboriginal_or_torres_strait_islander_medical_service_or_community_clinic_n) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(across(private_n:other_n,
                       ~ . / answered_n * 100,
                       .names = "{.col}_prop"),
                #
                answered_prop = answered_n / answered_n * 100) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_replace(., "_n_prop$", "_prop"), ends_with("_n_prop")) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::select(sex,
                starts_with("private"),
                starts_with("government"),
                starts_with("school"),
                starts_with("ams"),
                starts_with("other"),
                starts_with("answered")) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_longer(!sex,
                      names_to      = c("answer", ".value"),
                      names_pattern = "(.+)_(.+)") %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(answer = factor(dplyr::recode(answer,
                                              "private"    = "Private clinic",
                                              "government" = "Government clinic or dental hospital",
                                              "school"     = "School clinic",
                                              "ams"        = "AMS or Community Clinic",
                                              "other"      = "Other",
                                              "answered"   = "Total"),
                                levels = c("Private clinic",
                                           "Government clinic or dental hospital",
                                           "School clinic",
                                           "AMS or Community Clinic",
                                           "Other",
                                           "Total")))
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-peoples/national-aboriginal-and-torres-strait-islander-health-survey/latest-release).

- Overall, 40% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents living in Greater Melbourne reported that they had visited a dentist or dental professional during the six months prior to the survey. This equates to approximately 15,000 Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander people.

- Males were more likely than females to have never seen a dentist or dental professional (5.4% vs. 2.9%).

- For Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander survey respondents living in Greater Melbourne who had ever visited a dentist or dental professional, 54% (approximately 19,300 people) attended their most recent consultation at a private dental clinic, and a further 23% (approximately 8,200 people) attended a government clinic or dental hospital.

- Males were more likely than females to have attended an Aboriginal Medical Service (AMS) or Community Clinic for their most recent dental consultation (13% vs. 7.7%).

::: {.callout-tip title="Definitions and notes about this topic" icon=false collapse=false}
- Data for this topic were collected from all people completing the 2022-23 ABS National Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Survey.

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

- `r note_aboriginality_natsihs`
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Survey questions for this topic" icon=false collapse=false}
- In the last two weeks, have you been to the dentist, doctor, or nurse about your teeth, gums, or false teeth?
  - `r note_response_binary`

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

- When was the last time you went to the dentist?
  - Less than three months ago
  - Three months to less than six months age
  - Six months to less than 12 months ago
  - 12 months to less than 2 years ago
  - 2 years ago or more
  - Never seen health professional about teeth

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

- Where did you last go to see the dentist?
  - Private dental clinic (including specialist)
  - Government dental clinic (including dental hospital)
  - School dental clinic
  - Aboriginal Medical Service or Community Clinic
  - Other

:::
